tasks.description: Prisma: add enums AbsenceNoteStatus/AbsenceReason/ConsentResponseValue and models AbsenceNote, ConferenceEvent, ConferenceSlot (+blocked), ConsentForm (+lastRemindedAt, +dueReminderSentAt, eventId FK to CalendarEvent), ConsentAudience (reuses AudienceType), ConsentResponse @@unique(formId,studentId); @db.Date for date-only fields; index AbsenceNote(studentId,status,fromDate). Migration adds raw-SQL partial unique index ConferenceSlot(eventId,teacherId,bookedForStudentId) WHERE bookedForStudentId IS NOT NULL. Run prisma generate.

Zod validators shared by forms and handlers, mirroring api-contracts.json components: absence note (toDate>=fromDate, span<=30d, details<=1000, periodIds only when partialDay, -14/+60 day window via superRefine), review (reject requires note), conference event (slotMinutes 5-60, window ordering), availability ranges, slot patch, booking (parentNote<=500), consent form (audience types GRADE_LEVEL/SECTION/COURSE only), consent response (value, signature, comment); list query schemas with page/pageSize<=100/sort/q.

Pure helpers (no Prisma) + FR-46 unit tests: coversRecord(note,{date,periodId}) (whole-day, partial periods, multi-day, null periodId = daily homeroom covered by any note on that date); generateSlots(ranges,slotMinutes) + overlaps(a,b); signatureMatches(typed,fullName) via trim().toLowerCase().

Register notification types (absence_note.submitted email false, absence_note.reviewed true, conference.slots_requested, conference.booked, conference.cancelled, consent.requested true, consent.reminder true); register 'absence-note' file context resolver (any linked parent, homeroom teacher of the student's current section, ADMIN); restrict 'absence-note' uploads to PDF/JPG/PNG in checkType.

Child context: getSelectedChild(user, searchParams?) wrapped in React cache() — linked ?studentId ▸ linked sh_child cookie ▸ first linked child (never throws on bad cookie); setSelectedChildCookie validates ParentStudentLink then sets httpOnly/sameSite=lax/path=//1y cookie. POST /api/me/selected-child route (PARENT only, unlinked id → 404).

Top-bar ChildSwitcher (MUI Select + UserAvatar; one child = name only, no dropdown; change POSTs /api/me/selected-child then router.refresh()); app layout loads linked children + selected child and a homeroom flag; shell renders switcher for PARENT; navigation entries — Parent: My children, Absence notes, Conferences, Consent forms; Teacher: Absence notes (requires homeroom), Conferences; Admin: Conferences, Consent forms, Absence notes. mui-mcp lookup per component.

absence-notes-service: submit (PENDING, assertCanViewStudent, fileId with absence-note context, notify absence_note.submitted to homeroom teacher + ADMINs), list (role-scoped, paginated), getForReview (joins AttendanceRecords for the date range), review ($transaction: updateMany status PENDING→decision count 0 → 409 ALREADY_REVIEWED; on APPROVE convert covered ABSENT records to EXCUSED with note 'Absence note #<id>' and create EXCUSED records for existing sessions without one; after commit audit({request}) and notify absence_note.reviewed with reviewNote), findCovering(studentIds, dateRange, statuses), homeroomTeacherOf, assertHomeroomOrAdmin.
Absence notes API: GET/POST /api/absence-notes, GET /api/absence-notes/:id, POST /api/absence-notes/:id/review — withHandler → requireRole → Zod → service → ok/paginated per api-contracts.json.

Attendance integration (edit in place): getRegister pre-fills EXCUSED + noteId/excusable for students covered by an APPROVED note; saveRegister (~line 219) allows EXCUSED for ADMIN or when an APPROVED note covers the record; before notifyStudentAndParents (~line 299) drop attendance.absent for students covered by PENDING/APPROVED notes. Update the attendance validator comment on the EXCUSED rule. RegisterForm shows 'Absence note' Chip badge and enables EXCUSED per excusable.

Parent absence UI: /my-children/[studentId]/absence/new form (RHF + shared Zod, DatePicker from/to, RadioGroup whole day/periods, Checkbox group from bell-schedule Periods, reason, details, FileUpload context absence-note, useToast) and /my-children/[studentId]/absence list (DataTable + status Chip). Server pages assertCanViewStudent.

Review queue /attendance/absence-notes (homeroom TEACHER own section, ADMIN all): DataTable with status/date filters; detail Dialog with note, document link, existing attendance records, Approve (optional note) / Reject (note required); toasts on 409.

conferences-service: createEvent/updateEvent (ADMIN, notify conference.slots_requested to teachers of eligible grade levels; PATCH 409 if booked slots exist and date/slotMinutes change; audit), setAvailability ($transaction delete unbooked&unblocked, insert generateSlots), setSlotBlocked, removeSlot (unbooked only), listBookable(event, child), book (window guard → 400 OUTSIDE_BOOKING_WINDOW; in $transaction overlap check → 409 OVERLAP 'You already have a meeting with <teacher> at <time>'; updateMany where bookedByParentId null & blocked false, count 0 → 409 SLOT_TAKEN 'That slot was just taken'; P2002 → 409 ONE_PER_TEACHER), cancel (before bookingClosesAt), notify conference.booked/cancelled with ics link, teacherDay, listMyMeetings, slotIcs via calendar/ical.ts.

Conferences API: GET/POST /api/conferences, GET/PATCH /api/conferences/:id, PUT /api/conferences/:id/availability, GET /api/conferences/:id/slots (?view=day), PATCH/DELETE /api/conference-slots/:id, POST /api/conference-slots/:id/book, POST /api/conference-slots/:id/cancel, GET /api/conference-slots/:id/ics (text/calendar).
Admin conference UI /admin/conferences: DataTable of events, create/edit Dialog form (title, DatePicker date, DateTimePicker booking window, slot length, Autocomplete grade levels).

Conference pages for teachers and the role-based list: /conferences event list per role; /conferences/[id]/availability (time-range rows, location TextField, slot list with remove/block IconButtons); /conferences/[id]/day printable Table of booked slots (student, parent, note) with @media print via sx.

Parent booking page /conferences/[id]: for the selected child, one section per teacher with slot Buttons/ToggleButtons, optional note Dialog, own booking with Cancel (reschedule = cancel + book), 409 → toast + refetch slots.

consent-forms-service: create (canTargetAudience per row, insert form+audiences, notify consent.requested to linked parents of resolved audience students), list (staff own/all; parent per child with pending/responded), get, respond (assertCanViewStudent, dueAt guard → 400 PAST_DUE, signatureMatches → 400 SIGNATURE_MISMATCH, upsert by (formId,studentId), audit before/after with request), tracking (Granted/Declined/No response, filters, CSV via src/server/csv.ts), remind (claim lastRemindedAt 24h else 429 with retryAfterMs; notify consent.reminder to non-responders), sendConsentDueReminders(now) (dueAt in (now,now+48h], claim dueReminderSentAt). assertConsentOwnerOrAdmin. Wire sendConsentDueReminders into the cron dispatch route as an isolated try-block.

Consent forms API: GET/POST /api/consent-forms, GET /api/consent-forms/:id, POST /api/consent-forms/:id/responses, GET /api/consent-forms/:id/tracking[?format=csv], POST /api/consent-forms/:id/remind.

Consent list + create UI: /consent-forms (parent: pending/responded per selected child; staff: own/all forms) and /consent-forms/new (title, MarkdownEditor description, due date, Autocomplete CalendarEvent link, audience picker following the announcements audience UI pattern).

Consent detail + tracking UI: /consent-forms/[id] (MarkdownView description, respond form: RadioGroup Granted/Declined, signature TextField, comment; editable until dueAt) and /consent-forms/[id]/tracking (creator/ADMIN only: DataTable with status filter, CSV export link, 'Remind non-responders' Button with 429 toast).

overview-service: getChildrenSummary(parent) (term attendance rate, missing-assignment count, average grade per child) and one function per card — getToday (timetable + holidays), getAttendanceSummary (rate, absences, lates, last 5 marks), getAssignmentsSummary (missing + due next 7 days), getRecentGrades (last 5 visible + current percent per course), listUnreadAnnouncements (returns [] — PRD-12 absent), getUpcomingEvents (next 5 CalendarEvents via audienceWhereForUser + recurrence, plus 'My meetings'), getTeachers, getActionItems (pending consent + open conferences). Reuse existing services; schoolToday for date rules.
Overview API: GET /api/me/children/summary, GET /api/students/:id/overview (?cards= filter; assertCanViewStudent).

Overview UI: /my-children (one child → redirect to overview; else summary Cards), /my-children/[studentId] server page (assertCanViewStudent, header paints first, 8 async cards each in <Suspense fallback={<LoadingSkeleton/>}> with 'View all' links to /students/[id] tabs, /assignments, /grades, absence form, /consent-forms, /conferences; Announcements → EmptyState); /dashboard redirects PARENT to /my-children.

Adopt sh_child default on existing parent pages: /assignments and /grades resolve studentId via getSelectedChild (?studentId= stays an override) and drop their per-page child selectors; /api/me/timetable defaults PARENT target to the selected child.

Seed (extend prisma/seed.ts in place, idempotent): Grade 7 one PENDING + one APPROVED absence note; 'Autumn conferences' 3 weeks out for Grade 7 with Tom and Tina slots 15:00–17:00 at 10 min, two booked; 'Science Museum Trip' consent form for Grade 7 due in 10 days linked to a seeded CalendarEvent with ~40% responses.

Integration tests (Vitest + DB): approval converts ABSENT→EXCUSED and leaves PRESENT untouched; future-register pre-fill; attendance.absent suppressed while a PENDING note covers the student; two concurrent book() calls via Promise.all → exactly one success, other 409.
Playwright specs: absence note → approve → register shows EXCUSED; book a conference slot; sign a consent form.

notes: NFR-4: every MUI component must be looked up with mui-mcp (useMuiDocs + fetchDocs) before use; MCP unreachable = blocker. No banned imports.
NFR-7 gates after every task: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test; logger, never console.log.
NFR-9 scope: no Announcement model (FR-13 partial), no calendar page/filter (FR-35 and FR-5 calendar part partial) — ADR-11.
422 business-rule failures map to 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with details.reason (http.ts has no 422). Unviewable resource → 404; forbidden action → 403; races → 409; remind throttle → 429.
No new dependencies (ADR-1). Migration timestamp 20261114000000 follows the latest existing 20261113000000_add_calendar.
